$comment: Two projects as the M7 kit made them (packages/create at commit 834a060^, the last before the @foreman-kit rename): `create m7-app --no-install --no-git`, and `init` on a git repo with a small package.json. Only the files sync's migration reads are kept; the vendored tarballs are placeholders, and the test writes the kit's current .claude files for the other paths the record lists.

{
  "name": "m7-app",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "bun --watch src/cli.ts serve",
    "serve": "bun src/cli.ts serve",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "bun test",
    "db:generate": "drizzle-kit generate",
    "db:migrate": "bun src/cli.ts db:migrate",
    "docs:check": "docs-check",
    "tokens": "design-kit tokens src/ui/tokens.css",
    "design:check": "design-kit lint src && design-kit tokens src/ui/tokens.css --check",
    "screenshot": "design-kit screenshot",
    "check": "bun run typecheck && bun run docs:check && bun run design:check && bun run test"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "drizzle-orm": "0.45.3",
    "postgres": "3.4.9",
    "zod": "4.6.7"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@meta-repo/design-kit": "file:.meta-repo/packages/design-kit-3213a5b7de37.tgz",
    "@meta-repo/docs-check": "file:.meta-repo/packages/docs-check-c155013eb0f9.tgz",
    "@meta-repo/foreman": "file:.meta-repo/packages/foreman-07e4f7c3286a.tgz",
    "@meta-repo/test-kit": "file:.meta-repo/packages/test-kit-7f5ddafe8d01.tgz",
    "@types/bun": "1.3.5",
    "drizzle-kit": "0.31.11",
    "typescript": "5.9.3"
  }
}
create..claude/settings.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/claude-code-settings.json",
  "permissions": {
    "deny": [
      "Bash(git push --force *)",
      "Bash(git push -f *)",
      "Bash(git push * --force)",
      "Bash(git push * --force *)",
      "Bash(git push * -f)",
      "Bash(git push * -f *)",
      "Bash(git push --force-with-lease*)",
      "Bash(git push * --force-with-lease*)",
      "Bash(git push * +*)",
      "Bash(git push origin main)",
      "Bash(git push origin main *)",
      "Bash(git push * main)",
      "Bash(git push * HEAD:main)",
      "Bash(git push origin master)",
      "Bash(git push * master)",
      "Bash(git push * --no-verify*)",
      "Bash(git commit --no-verify*)",
      "Bash(git commit * --no-verify*)",
      "Bash(git reset --hard*)",
      "Bash(rm -rf *)",
      "Bash(rm -fr *)",
      "Bash(rm -r -f *)",
      "Bash(gh repo delete*)",
      "Bash(gh secret *)",
      "Bash(gh auth *)",
      "Read(**/.env)",
      "Read(**/.env.local)",
      "Read(**/.env.*.local)",
      "Read(**/.env.development)",
      "Read(**/.env.production)",
      "Read(**/.env.staging)",
      "Read(**/.env.test)",
      "Read(**/*.pem)",
      "Read(**/*.key)",
      "Read(~/.ssh/**)",
      "Read(~/.aws/**)",
      "Read(~/.config/gh/**)"
    ],
    "ask": [
      "Bash(gh pr merge *)",
      "Bash(gh api * -X *)",
      "Bash(gh api * --method *)",
      "Bash(docker *)",
      "Bash(ssh *)",
      "Bash(scp *)"
    ],
    "allow": [
      "Bash(git status*)",
      "Bash(git diff*)",
      "Bash(git log*)",
      "Bash(git show*)",
      "Bash(git branch --show-current)",
      "Bash(git fetch*)",
      "Bash(gh pr view*)",
      "Bash(gh pr checks*)",
      "Bash(gh pr list*)",
      "Bash(gh pr diff*)",
      "Bash(gh repo view*)",
      "Read(**/.env.example)"
    ]
  },
  "hooks": {
    "PreToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Bash|Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit|Read|mcp__.*",
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo \"guard: bun is not installed, so commands and edits cannot be checked (install it from https://bun.sh)\" >&2; exit 2; }; bun \"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/guard.ts\"",
            "timeout": 10
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "SessionStart": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; bun \"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/session-start.ts\"",
            "timeout": 15
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
